notable_absence.finding: The `full_backup` request-body field is used in the worked example (`{"full_backup": false}`) but never once documented in prose, in a parameters table, or in the syntax block above it - the page's own HTTP Methods and URIs / Description / Curl Syntax sections describe the endpoint as taking no body at all. A reader following only the documented syntax would not know this parameter exists; it is only discoverable from the example. Recorded as configurableVia on the strength of the example rather than a documented parameter, and flagged here as a gap rather than treated as if it were formally specified.

cross_component_finding: The 500 error example on this page ('failed bucket check for bucket 'travel-sample': bucket UUIDs don't match...') is byte-for-byte identical to the one on backup-trigger-prune.md (this same batch) - both pages share not just the error shape but the exact bucket name and UUID pair in their worked examples, suggesting both were authored from the same underlying test run/fixture rather than independently. Minor, but useful corroboration that 'backup' and 'prune' tasks in the Backup Service go through the same bucket-validation code path, reinforcing that they are siblings of one task family (backup:backup-task) rather than differently-implemented features.
